entries.en: heavy, so that it cannot be lifted

entries.zh: 极度悲痛、心中焦躁烦闷（原字疑为「燥」或「燡」）
entries.en: great grief; burning vexation of heart
entries.notes: H 栏「燡/燥」存疑、M 栏末音仅存「n.」缩写，据 L「pesadumbre muy grande」定「极度悲苦」。

entries.zh: 阻碍、牵累，使人有所妨碍
entries.en: hindrance, impediment; a burden that obstructs
entries.notes: H 栏首字「挂/掸」存疑，M 栏 cua 可证其为「挂」。

entries.zh: 可悲、令人伤痛；向人致哀吊慰
称一称，看它有多重（西语原文讹误）
entries.en: to weigh it; to find out how much it weighs (text corrupt)
entries.notes: L 栏「procurar lo pesa」讹误、H 栏疑误，据 M 栏末二音「偌濟」推为「称看有多重」。

entries.en: to weigh with a steelyard; steelyard
to weigh by sliding the steelyard weight
to weigh out medicines; to make up a prescription
entries.notes: H 栏「配/沛」存疑，M 栏 pay 可证其为「配」。

entries.en: heavy steelyard; to weigh with a large steelyard

entries.zh: 称量银两；熔铸银料（四栏义有出入，存疑）
entries.en: to weigh silver; to smelt or cast silver (columns inconsistent)
entries.notes: H 栏「陶鎔/陶錄」与 L「称银」义不合，M 仅存 to iong 二音，语义存疑。
H/M/R 三栏全空，L 栏残句「Duuār ge kiñca, piña」无法成义，疑为串行或「piña」残条。

entries.en: to regret, to be sorry; anger
entries.notes: L 栏拼合讹误（「Pesarle ó enojo」），按「pesar」懊悔义与「恨」对应。

entries.zh: 为将来可能遭遇的不幸而预先忧伤
entries.en: to grieve beforehand over future misfortunes; to dread coming evils
entries.notes: M 栏后二音节无法与 H 栏对应，据 L「males futuros」与「悼」定「预先忧悼」。
